title: Acceptance-evaluation submission into Engram exceeds TermAl's 6000 ms host-adapter deadline
outcome: Acceptance-evaluation submission into Engram exceeds TermAl's 6000 ms host-adapter deadline
acceptance: The slow path is identified from measured evidence on the affected store and item: which Engram operation, which query or scan, and how its time grows with the item's notes, evidence, children or the store's size

Under concurrent writers, an acceptance-evaluation submission completes within the operation limit, with a minimum 60-second limit and one shared absolute lock-wait budget rather than a separate five-second budget at each acquisition; the opener-plus-writer sequence is covered by behavioral evidence.
No retry, timeout extension or partial write is used to hide the slowness; a submission that does time out leaves no half-recorded evaluation
